_meta.rationale: Linear's DRL tokens carry Inter as the display-slot font. _slot_first_preference('display', tokens)='Inter'; lookup('inter') -> brand_font_name='Inter', free_alternative_name='Inter'. Disclosure renders 'Linear uses Inter.' About-team title element is .at__title. Phase 3.2 strips photo avatars. Negative trademark scan covers slug=linear strip targets. Confirmed 2026-06-13 via prod DB probe.
gaps: Linear is not in BRAND_FONT_REGISTRY by brand slug. Lookup goes by font family name ('inter'). No registry change needed.
fidelity_targets.yml updated 2026-06-13; Linear now in targets.

assertions.evaluate: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('.at__title'); if (!el) return false; const fam = window.getComputedStyle(el).fontFamily || ''; return fam.toLowerCase().includes('inter'); })()

(() => { const html = document.documentElement.outerHTML.toLowerCase(); const forbidden = ['linear.app/logo', 'linear-logo', 'linear-mark', '/logo.svg', '/wordmark.svg', '/brand/logo']; return forbidden.every(s => !html.includes(s)); })()
(() => { const members = document.querySelectorAll('.at__member'); if (members.length === 0) return false; for (const m of members) { if (m.querySelector('img')) return false; } return true; })()
